title: Archived price points — FrontDeskReview
method: For each product, Internet Archive snapshots of a public page that published the figure were read and the displayed US selling price extracted verbatim — the product's own source page wherever the archive holds one, otherwise the named retailer or reference page the point was read from; ambiguous snapshots (JS-only rendering, unresolvable variants) were dropped rather than guessed. Every point carries its snapshot URL, so the host a figure came from is on the record rather than assumed and any reader can verify it independently.
boundary: A separate record from our own tracking (/data/price-history.jsonl). Archive points are NOT observations we made and never feed 'lowest on record' or volatility computations.
